description: Staging invitation emails for publication, cancellation and rescheduling.

preconditions: A Published meeting with Organizer-Chair An, Member Bình and one active Guest; An cancels it.
cases.inputs: meeting; historyId H1; actorId An; reason "Hoãn do lịch bận".
cases.return: No result. Three Cancelled dispatches staged, all with event id H1 and deduplication key roster:H1:Cancelled:<owner id>.
cases.log: An in-app notification "Cuộc họp đã bị huỷ" (body: Cuộc họp “<title>” đã bị huỷ. Lý do: Hoãn do lịch bận) is staged for Bình only; none for An (the actor) and none for the Guest. The dispatch payload carries the reason.

preconditions: A meeting with only the actor as participant.
cases.return: One dispatch for the actor, no in-app notification.

preconditions: A meeting with no active participants and no Guests.

cases.inputs: reason: 1000 characters; a Member in the roster.
cases.return: The in-app body holds the whole reason (about 1040 characters, below its 2000-character limit); the dispatch payload keeps it too.
